items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Edgar Sampson was in the band too. We went there, opened up there in 1927, played there in '27-28.

ctx.x: Well, how long did you stay there with Gibbs?
We -- let's see, Arthur Gibbs, we went there in -- Edgar Sampson was in the band too. We went there, opened up there in 1927, played there in '27-28. '29 we went down to the ballroom downtown.
